core_obligations: the first statement follows from the empirical ball theorem together with the error bound of kernel herding
the second statement bounds the probability of a large deviation of the empirical mean by an exponential estimate
a ball of radius delta/2 around the mean inside the affine span of the data is obtained with the stated probability depending on the density constant c, the Lipschitz constant L and the dimension
the third statement iterates the compression step, geometric decay reducing the error until the n^{-1/2} threshold is reached and giving the stated number of steps t

difficulty_reason: H2按完整RKHS-compression链保留：1704-1772由Mercer width与Lipschitz/density lower bound给population convex hull内球，对所有方向的smoothed support-function用uniform empirical concentration控制，把内球传至sample convex hull并从mean中心移到empirical mean；2903-2976再在有球/无球两事件上分别给kernel-herding O(1/t)/O(1/sqrt(t))，组合tail probability与stopping-time bound。非例行处是随机convex geometry的统一内半径控制及有限维compression，不是孤立代常数或原H3标签。CGM/regression variants及covariance工具关联原作者全源不另拆。
